title: Moon Dust document: fireball and silent aircraft at a Bolivian crash site

tellings.quote: Another details a fireball and subsequent sightings of silent aircraft near a Bolivian crash site.

plain: A declassified document from Moon Dust, a US government effort to recover objects that fell from the sky, describes a fireball in Bolivia followed by sightings of silent aircraft near the crash site. Michels tells this himself, citing the document, as a sign that the US was quietly tracking and retrieving unexplained crashes abroad.
